notes: Clicked for credits for most of the game while sitting on 17-25 credits with no installs, facechecked repeatedly with no breakers, and re-ran an already seen Obokata twice; let Timely Public Release and Obokata be advanced over turns unchallenged.
Floated 14-19 credits while clicking for credits for several turns and left an agenda-heavy HQ behind one cheap ice (Philotic stolen); the Snare and Fetal AI trap line did win via flatline.

Good early R&D pressure, but most of the R&D runs each turn re-accessed the same top card and it sat at 0 credits; later it banked 20+ credits clicking for credits for many turns, never running HQ or remotes while the Corp fast-advanced to 7.
A sensible scoring remote and good use of Seamless Launch, but several turns of clicking for credits with a 6-card hand and little development; it was only lightly tested by a passive runner.
Steady HQ/R&D pressure with Aumakua and a well-judged Obokata steal at a safe hand size; took many Liza tags loosely and made an early facecheck into a remote.
Twice installed agendas behind unrezzed ice with only 2 credits to rez it (Offworld Office, Cyberdex Sandbox), and both walked off; R&D was also thin and the economy never recovered.
Won, but skipped Archives for two turns while the Corp was discarding 4 cards a turn, which delayed a win that was available, and spent several clicks on Spy Camera churn.

Clicked for credits nearly every turn up to 48 credits without installing or running, and ignored a naked remote Atlas that was scored the next turn; it won only because Audacity and discards dumped agendas into Archives.
Left R&D open early, held an agenda in a one-Vanilla HQ, and left Ikawah advanced overnight behind one ice; Biotic Labor was spent just to click for credits.
Good fast-advance scoring with Biotic Labor and Jeeves, but many turns of clicking for credits with a full hand and discards, and Remote Enforcement was left overnight behind a single ice and stolen.
Sound scoring remote behind Fairchild and efficient closeouts, but spent many early turns clicking for credits at 13-18 credits and discarding to hand size.
Spent most of the game at 2-5 credits, unable to contest the remote where the Corp scored Offworld and GFI; it facechecked Border Control with no money and wasted 4 credits on a second Paperclip.

Built a 4-ice remote but was too broke to rez it, so two agendas were stolen through unrezzed ice; Biotic Labor and NEXT Activation Command were used for nothing, and it won via a fortunate Mavirus flatline.

Spent seven straight turns running Archives four times to re-see the same Obokata while banking 29 credits, never drawing up to take it or contesting the remotes where Obokata and Send a Message were advanced over several turns.
Good economy, a timely R&D steal and well-planned card draw to take Obokata for the win; it did run into a known DNA Tracker unbroken and lose cards and credits.
Installed three agendas in a row behind one ice it could not afford to rez, and all three were stolen; it then clicked for credits for six turns with a full hand, discarding.
Punished the Corp quickly with Archives, remote and HQ steals and good use of Dirty Laundry and Moshing; the only oddity was eating a Mausolus tag.

Mushin No Shin put Gila Hands into a naked remote and an extra click went into advancing it uselessly, so it was stolen at once; the Corp then sat at 0-5 credits all game while R&D stayed lightly defended.
Ansel protected the first agenda well and later agendas were scored behind layered ice; advancing GFI over three turns was a small risk.

Ran R&D four times per turn re-seeing the same card, then clicked for credits for many turns, never running a 7-9 card HQ; with 22+ credits it did not run the remote where the winning Elective Upgrade was advanced.
